FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now fluttering in the wind with a faintly distorted, VHS-like quality.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a stout and proud man in his late 40s, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But as he speaks, his words are laced with a newfound sense of detachment, a sense of longing for something more.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
We must modernize, my friends. We must adapt to the changing times.

ADVISOR 1
But, Your Majesty, the people love our traditional ways. They love the grandeur and pageantry of our kingdom.

KING ARIN
(sighing)
I know, I know. But think of the possibilities. Think of the... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...the "futurism" of it all.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's advisors are seen wandering the castle grounds, taking notes and snapping photographs. They are all wearing strange, futuristic-looking headsets, and their clothes are adorned with tiny, flashing lights.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors return, bearing strange, glowing artifacts. They are placed upon the throne, and the king's eyes light up with excitement.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
Behold! The "Vaporwave of the Ancients"!

The advisors nod, and the camera zooms in on the artifacts, which begin to glow with a soft, ethereal light.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The stone walls are now covered in a thick, misty haze, and the flags bearing the royal crest now flutter in the wind with a faintly distorted, VHS-like quality. The people of the kingdom are seen wandering the streets, wearing strange, futuristic-looking clothing and listening to music on tiny, portable devices.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But this time, they are all wearing strange, futuristic-looking headsets, and their clothes are adorned with tiny, flashing lights.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
We are the pioneers of a new era. We are the... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...the "futurists" of the medieval world.

The advisors nod, and the camera zooms in on the king's face, which is now shrouded in a misty haze.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
